title: A realization respects the coefficient augmentations
statement: For a scheme X, module sheaves F,G, resolution pairing D [def-sc-module-cup-resolution-data], and t satisfying D.Realizes t [def-sc-module-cup-realization-complex-data], let aF,aG,aT be the actual extended cochain augmentations, from the appropriate degree-zero single complexes to the extended resolutions. Then (aF tensor aG) followed by t equals the canonical single-tensor isomorphism [lem-sc-module-cup-canonical-hzero-identification] followed by aT. This is an equality of cochain maps before localization, not an equality of derived maps or H-zero maps.

source.place: Cohomology of Sheaves, section-cup-product: construction before Lemma 20.31.3 and its global specialization

proof.text: The source tensor of single complexes is concentrated in degree zero; all other components vanish. Identify its degree-zero summand with F tensor G. Test equality on elementary tensors of sections over every open, using the tensor/sheafification universal property. Realizes at bidegree (0,0) followed by augmentation_pair identifies the two values. The extension/single and tensor/single isomorphisms have their canonical degree-zero components, so the resulting sheaf morphism equality is precisely the stated equation. Apply degreewise extensionality.
